Name: Improved Riverland Farm fix
Author: Zedster3738
Description:
I made this fix, since the mod "Improved Riverland Farm" was last updated in 2019 and used an old layout with the shipping bin and mailbox painted partly on the ground, which made the shipping bin always jumping a pixel around when opened (mind boggling for me) and made it unbearable to play if you moved the greenhouse or the farmhouse around, since the buildings still occupied their old places too.

One edit i also made is that the fence next to the pet bowl is removed, since you can now move the pet bowl too, so you have more freedom in your farm layout.


One bug i encountered is that the Event for the "A Winter Mystery" quest doesn't get triggered in winter year 1. If you encounter this too, try to type in the SMAPI console window: "debug ebi 520702" without the quotes. That should trigger the not initiated scene.

First you have to install "[CP] Imrpoved Riverland Farm" from Laurezard and then you unzip this fix into your MOD folder and overwrite any files from "[CP] Improved Riverland Farm".
NOTE that this is a modified version of the original Content Patcher version from Laurezard made with the help of Blyndshot, so you need Content Patcher, SMAPI and the original mod too, don't know if it works with the non CP version too.

Downloads.Description: Just copy this over Laurezards mod in the mod folder.
